title: export.start
description: Start exporting a sequence to 'output_path'. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.8 export.start (confirmation class). 'preset' is an Oak export preset name - the preset set is app-configured and therefore open (OPP/1 v1 exposes no custom encoding). Progress is delivered as export.progress/export.done events handled by the T4 hooks layer, not as part of this tool's result.

sequence.description: Sequence to export (required by OPP/1 section 8.8).

preset.description: Oak export preset name. Open set: preset names come from the host configuration, so no enum is frozen here (see method-map.md open items).
